packageRules.description: Hard-pin build backend + dev deps to exact versions. Runtime dependencies stay ranges: they are what a project installing dj-turso resolves against.

The polls example depends on dj-turso by path, so its uv.lock records the ROOT manifest's requires-dev. Any root dependency bump makes it stale and the examples job, which runs `uv run pytest`, re-resolves a set nobody reviewed. Renovate's uv manager only refreshes the lockfile beside the manifest it edited, so re-lock it in the same branch.

Turso releases carry the upstream fixes dj-turso waits on, so they skip the cooloff, in both places (see [tool.uv.exclude-newer-package]). Merged by hand: dj-turso imports pyturso's private turso._turso module, the runtime ranges cap the minor version, and a release that fixes a tracked upstream bug turns its strict xfail in tests/index.toml into an XPASS to clean up.
uv has no release timestamps; skip cooloff.
